items.title: 67426_Hayes Pillars oral history interview
items.q: The interviewee mentions Fletcher Henderson only in the context of a saxophone player who 'formerly played with Fletcher Henderson' and later when reading in the newspaper that 'Fletcher Henderson was finishing his engagement'. There is no direct interaction or personal relationship described betwee

ctx.x: Piecing that up, see. But anyway, the band was still sounding good. The band sounded good all through that year. We hired -- it was a dark boy who played tenor sax that formerly played with Fletcher Henderson. I can't think of his name. He didn't stay there long.
Was that before I went in the service,
